notes: Viewed all 66 org-* image files on disk (148 image refs across 152 posts). DATA PROBLEM: 111 posts (79 TrAC, 12 AIIRA, 20 COALESCE) were scraped with url=null/timestamp=null, and their images were all saved as org-<slug>-ED_RELEVANCE-<n>.<ext>, so each filename was overwritten by later posts; only the last writer survives (verified by sha256). Lost images include: REU-TrACE Collins Aerospace visit (5 photos), first Statewide High School AI Hackathon wrap-up (4), TrAC Holiday Lunch (2), CVPR 2026 Day 1 photos 1-2 from Tirtho Roy's post, ICRA 2026 'Find the Fruit' post (Nitesh Subedi, Hsin-Jung Yang), Sarkar Mid-Career Achievement award post, and more. Fix scrape_org.py's pid fallback (re.search(r'(.{12})$', key) yields 'ED_RELEVANCE' for every card) and re-scrape to recover them. Picks with link=null (Lunch Seminar, K-State keynote, AIIRA NIFA visit) have no captured URL; date is null or derived (see approxDate) - a human should find the post URLs. Dates for K-State (talks-video.json) and Lunch Seminar (post text) are not from timestamps. Dedup: org-*-ED_RELEVANCE files from REU 2026 and CVPR posts were hash-identical to existing gallery images (7470572643738644480-2/3, 7468805740057546752-2/3/4) and skipped; org-coalesceiastate-ED_RELEVANCE-5/6 (autonomous trucks at CVPR) equal 7468805740057546752-6/7, previously rejected. Same-image duplicates across org pages (Genesis July coins/selfie, Capitol, AgGym, CORL, CVPR speaker card, World Food Prize flyer, Ag x BTO logo) were counted once. Excluded: Tirtho Roy alone at his CVPR 2026 SAGE poster (org-traciastate-ED_RELEVANCE-3.jpg, near-duplicate of gallery 7468805740057546752-4; post URL unknown), CVPR badge and acknowledgements slide, Genesis challenge coins, Genesis Feb panel/speaker shots (no lab link), second K-State talk photo (near-duplicate), AIIRA Valeria Fonseca Turcios AAEA posts (not lab), Capitol mascot photo and near-duplicate booth shot, AIIRA NIFA lunch photo, all flyers/logos/headshots/paper figures/blank GIF placeholders. Not named in captions: people in Capitol booth, NIFA visit and Feb Genesis photos are not identified by the post text (Feb Genesis names come only from visible badges).
